career_kiln_entry.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_entry.text: The kiln's gate had been repainted while Yue was away. Her old handprint survived beneath the latch, a patch where the wood had worn smooth before anybody thought of decoration. She touched it once and stepped aside for a cart. Returning felt easier until she saw the vacancy notice. It offered a technical trial, not the teaching season she had declined. She would have to apply before anybody could call her useful.

career_kiln_entry_02.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_entry_02.text: 'I kept your departure record,' Peng said, lifting a folder from beneath an unruly stack. 'It says you finished the term and returned the keys. This offer begins another term. Three supervised shifts, a practical review and a possible appointment. Your former work counts as evidence, but it cannot tell us whether you remember this year's equipment.' She had repaired the same paper cover Yue remembered. Its new stitches were green.

career_kiln_entry_03.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_entry_03.text: 'I remember telling people a beautiful vessel could still be unsuitable,' Yue said. 'I would like work that lets me find out before it reaches their kitchen.' The sentence sounded smaller than the ambitions she had practiced on the road, and more like something she could actually do. Peng asked whether that meant material examination, guarded instrument work or source records. Yue admitted she wanted to see the current tasks before choosing.

career_kiln_entry_04.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_entry_04.text: Peng wrote trainee technician on the offer, with no qualification implied by accepting it. Each completed shift paid six copper. A stopped shift paid its completed hours at the stated rate, with no lost examination fee. Meals and a bed came separately from the employment account. The practical review occupied paid training time; passing was not a condition for receiving wages already earned. Yue read the offer twice, the second time with her purse open.

career_kiln_entry_05.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_entry_05.text: The three shift payments totaled eighteen copper. Yue bought a two-copper notebook and reserved one copper for a letter; those were her own purchases, leaving fifteen from the new wages if she completed every shift. Peng entered neither item as a deduction. The hall set aside twelve copper for comparison stock and assessor time, independent of apprentice wages. Unused stock would stay with the hall. Nothing in the offer promised unlimited future study.

career_kiln_entry_06.speaker: luo_sheng
career_kiln_entry_06.text: Luo found her examining the new shutter. 'Five stages and still suspicious of hinges,' he said. Yue reminded him that hinges had never passed her cultivation examination. He smiled, then showed her the bench height and lifting limits. Her present clearance allowed ordinary waist work, with no sudden overhead catching. The vacancy would not demand that movement. If the tasks changed, the terms would have to change too.

career_kiln_entry_07.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_entry_07.text: Her earned fifth-stage record lay beside the task sheet. Four brief assessed pairs remained four brief assessed pairs; no job title would add a route or enlarge a tested input. Today's equipment could use its own isolated source. Yue's personal charge was optional within a guarded comparison and would receive its own measurement. Luo asked her to demonstrate a dry closure before even considering that option. She liked being remembered. She disliked being examined by someone who remembered her.

career_kiln_entry_08.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_entry_08.text: Zhu arrived carrying a gray tile under one arm and a blue tile under the other. 'My famous uninteresting piece has acquired another admirer,' she announced. The blue was for a display she still hoped to enter. The gray was the current reference sample. She would supervise cold material handling and later assess that portion of Yue's practical work. Luo could demonstrate the instrument, but he would not sign his own teaching as independent review.

career_kiln_entry_09.speaker: jian_rong
career_kiln_entry_09.text: Jian brought the tray covers without being asked to lift the tiles. His household qualification date had not become true while Yue traveled; his next warm-task assessment remained scheduled with his own teacher. 'You have come back to start below me,' he said, and looked horrified by his own pleasure. Yue considered pretending not to notice. Instead she answered, 'On this bench I have. Tell me where they keep the covers now.'

career_kiln_entry_10.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_entry_10.text: He showed her the cupboard, then the shelf that everyone still mistook for it. Familiarity did not make the directions obvious. Yue opened the wrong latch and found clean aprons. Jian laughed before asking whether laughter was permitted at a trainee. She said it depended on whether he supplied the right latch afterward. He did. The small embarrassment loosened something that five stages and an old friendship had made unexpectedly tight.

career_kiln_entry_11.speaker: tan_ning
career_kiln_entry_11.text: Tan posted the current contract beside the vacancy. The order waiting in the hall was for household bowls with broad, stable feet. Its purchaser wanted delivery before a naming feast; another maker might take the work if this hall ran late. 'That is the commercial pressure,' Tan said. 'It does not change the material test. I will tell the purchaser what we can actually promise.' He sounded as if he had practiced saying it before breakfast.

career_kiln_entry_12.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_entry_12.text: Yue signed for the three shifts, not the possible appointment. She could withdraw from a future shift without surrendering completed wages; the hall could decline to employ her after review without rewriting her old record. Her notebook looked embarrassingly bright beside Peng's repaired cover. She wrote the first line anyway: learn the equipment that is here. Below it she left room for a mistake she had not made yet.

career_kiln_entry_13.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_entry_13.text: Peng laid three learning cards on the table. One began with the guarded indicator, one with the cold vessel tray, and one with the source labels. They described different starting lessons within the same trainee term. None promised a title or an immediate gain. The choice would also determine the reference packet Yue kept for the later review. She could use a practiced comparison, or ask for the ordinary step-by-step lesson.

career_kiln_training_choice.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_training_choice.text: 'Choose the first lesson you want to carry into the review,' Peng said. 'The instrument card assumes practiced control; its trainer will still check the dry procedure. The vessel and source lessons begin with ordinary observation. They reach different reference packets, not different wages. You will perform all three shared shifts afterward. Learning where to begin is your decision. Calling that beginning completed work would be mine to resist.'

choices.text: Use practiced control to study the isolated indicator.
Learn the cold vessel comparison step by step.
Learn the source labels and retained failure record.

career_kiln_learn_indicator.speaker: luo_sheng
career_kiln_learn_indicator.text: Luo put the indicator on a timber stand with its source disconnected. He asked for the release sequence Yue remembered. She named the valve and missed the mechanical shutter. The new model placed that shutter behind the dial, where the old model had a fixed screen. Her prior control was useful only after the present arrangement became legible. She drew the hidden part before touching anything. Luo waited with his hands tucked into his sleeves.

career_kiln_learn_indicator_02.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_learn_indicator_02.text: The guarded trial used one measured input from the hall's isolated source. Yue observed the stop mark while Luo operated the admission. The needle returned slowly, then settled a hair above zero. She wanted that movement to mean her practiced eye had caught a defect. The unused dial beside it showed the same offset. Luo asked what temperature the two dials shared. Yue erased the premature conclusion and recorded the room's ordinary cold instead.

career_kiln_learn_indicator_03.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_learn_indicator_03.text: They warmed only the comparison dial by the specified method and repeated the unpowered observation. Its offset changed. That supported a temperature effect within these two instruments, leaving the active indicator's calibration unresolved. Yue copied both readings. Her first lesson had produced a better question rather than a triumphant diagnosis. She could carry that question into the receiving shift without being appointed the person responsible for every needle in the town.

career_kiln_learn_indicator_04.speaker: luo_sheng
career_kiln_learn_indicator_04.text: Luo gave her the instrument packet with the shutter drawing and paired readings. 'Keep the crossed-out diagnosis too,' he said. 'I want the assessor to see what changed your mind.' Yue asked whether he kept his own errors. He opened his notebook to a carefully reconstructed wrong valve order. The page looked older than the current indicator. He said teaching an error did not make repeating it acceptable; it made the reason for the correction available.

career_kiln_learn_indicator_05.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_learn_indicator_05.text: Yue closed the dry apparatus and returned the key to Luo. The supervised lesson had finished within its assigned hour, consuming one permitted comparison portion. It added no qualification and no new cultivation stage. She kept the authorized packet, including the wrong first diagnosis. The later review would ask her to explain a hidden offset using this instrument record. Beyond the door, an ordinary clay delivery had arrived with somebody else's time already running.

career_kiln_learn_vessel.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_learn_vessel.text: Zhu arranged three cold bowls with their feet hidden by cloth. Yue named the steadiest shape before the cloth came away. Zhu uncovered it: the broadest bowl had a poorly finished foot. 'You are remembering a design rule,' she said. 'Now test the actual piece.' They used the agreed flat board, leaving the household order untouched. The smallest bowl stood soundly. The broad one rocked whenever its marked high point crossed a scratch.

career_kiln_learn_vessel_02.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_learn_vessel_02.text: Yue wanted to sand the high point and demonstrate a repair. Zhu handed her the job card instead. These were retained comparison pieces; their owner had authorized examination, not alteration. A repair would consume evidence and require another decision. Yue set the abrasive down. She could feel the old worker's itch to leave a bench improved. Zhu said the itch was useful when the work actually included making things. Today it needed another outlet.

career_kiln_learn_vessel_03.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_learn_vessel_03.text: They traced the rocking bowl's foot onto a removable paper template. The uneven outline could be compared without changing the ceramic. Yue marked the scratch on the board and repeated the placement. This time the small bowl shifted slightly too. A crumb beneath its foot had changed the test. She swept the surface and began again, annoyed at how much dignity an ordinary crumb could remove from an experienced worker.

career_kiln_learn_vessel_04.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_learn_vessel_04.text: Zhu kept the contaminated placement in the packet. 'The board can fool you while the bowl is sound. The bowl can fool you while the design is sensible. Neither intends anything.' She laughed when Yue asked whether a trimmer was allowed to insult both. Then she showed her blue display tile, whose color she loved and whose firing record still needed a repeat. Wanting a beautiful result had not made that result available yet.

career_kiln_learn_vessel_05.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_learn_vessel_05.text: The cold lesson ended with a clean board comparison, three numbered outlines and the retained failed placement. Yue returned the actual bowls to their shelf. Her authorized packet would supply the later review's uneven-foot problem. She had earned an ordinary reference she understood, with no appointment attached to it. Zhu washed the cloth before the household order arrived; liking a lesson did not remove the need to finish its small practical mess.

career_kiln_learn_source.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_learn_source.text: Peng placed a firing card beside a specimen label. Their dates differed by one day. Yue reached for the discrepancy book and stopped when Peng asked which event each date named. The card named admission to the firing. The label named removal after cooling. No contradiction had yet appeared. 'I could create an impressive correction very quickly,' Yue said. Peng replied that impressive corrections usually took longer to undo than ordinary questions took to ask.

career_kiln_learn_source_02.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_learn_source_02.text: A second specimen did have a conflict: its copied label named a tray absent from the original receiving sheet. The original was held upstairs, and the clerk had permitted a supervised comparison after lunch. Yue marked the conflict unresolved. She could not transform a convenient reading into a repaired history merely because the shelf looked better without question marks. Peng showed where the undisputed credits remained usable while the disputed entry waited.

career_kiln_learn_source_03.speaker: tan_ning
career_kiln_learn_source_03.text: Tan brought the source sheet at the agreed hour. Its last digit had bled where rain reached the page. He had copied the most likely reading years ago and forgotten to mark it provisional. They could establish the copying error's status without establishing the vanished digit. He wrote that distinction himself. His impatience survived the correction; the purchaser still wanted a delivery date. Yue watched him carry an unfinished answer back into an ordinary working afternoon.

career_kiln_learn_source_04.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_learn_source_04.text: Yue asked whether the blank would make the archive look careless. Peng asked what an invented digit would make it do. They retained the original, numbered the permitted copy and placed Tan's signed explanation beside it. The packet contained a bounded correction and a question still open to later evidence. Yue had hoped to discover a clean answer. She left with a cleaner account of why there was not one.

career_kiln_learn_source_05.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_learn_source_05.text: Peng finished the lesson by having Yue return the specimen to its own shelf. No failed firing disappeared, and nobody's disputed credit became settled through her new handwriting. The authorized reference packet would support a later review of a copied label with an unreadable source. Yue carried the uncertainty willingly, though she still disliked its shape on the page. Outside, the receiving crew called for the first shift's actual delivery sheet.

career_kiln_shift_one.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_one.text: The first paid shift began with damp clay arriving in twelve covered tubs. Luo assigned Yue the waist-height receiving board under his supervision. She would number the tubs, compare the offered transport copy and preserve their actual order while the crew weighed them. She would not lift from the cart. The carter wanted the covers returned before his next delivery, so the sequence had an ordinary deadline that neither fear nor enthusiasm could cancel.

career_kiln_shift_one_02.speaker: luo_sheng
career_kiln_shift_one_02.text: Luo showed her the fresh scale check and asked her to copy its date. She copied yesterday's date from the adjacent repair notice. Jian noticed before the receiving tally left the board. Yue corrected it in the carter's presence, leaving the mistaken entry readable beneath one stroke. 'I have missed this kind of fame,' she said. Luo answered that he would advertise it only if she failed to check the rest of the page.

career_kiln_shift_one_03.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_one_03.text: She compared the remaining dates against the actual notices and found no further mismatch. That did not prove the clay's composition. The weighed amounts belonged to this receiving event; the supplier's batch description remained a separate offered claim. A tub cover split when the carter loosened its rope. The crew put a clean temporary cover over the tub and retained the loose fragment beside the delivery number. Yue recorded the replacement before it became invisible.

career_kiln_shift_one_04.speaker: jian_rong
career_kiln_shift_one_04.text: Jian fetched the spare cover from the proper cupboard this time. 'If the clay is wrong, they'll remember my rope,' he muttered. Yue asked whether he had supplied the rope. He had not. He wanted to be spared another story in which a material fault attached itself to whichever apprentice stood nearby. Luo heard him and assigned the cover record to the receiving event. The explanation protected a fact; it promised nothing about the untested clay.

career_kiln_shift_one_05.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_shift_one_05.text: The supplier's copy described all twelve tubs as one batch. The original receiving sequence placed the repaired cover between two tubs carrying a different depot mark. Yue asked the carter whether the tubs had been rearranged. He said a wheel repair had required unloading at the depot. He could offer that account but not the depot's book. She recorded it beside the observed marks. His time mattered enough to ask one clear question instead of five suspicious ones.

career_kiln_shift_one_06.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_one_06.text: Luo separated the uncertain tub from the soundly matched receiving group without opening it. The purchaser's bowls would use the verified material already held in the hall. This delayed part of the new stock while preserving the actual deadline for what could be made. Tan went to explain the narrowed plan. He looked at the tub as if it were a troublesome sentence, then asked Yue for the exact uncertainty rather than a convenient accusation.

career_kiln_shift_one_07.speaker: tan_ning
career_kiln_shift_one_07.text: 'I can tell the buyer we have enough verified stock for the agreed number,' Tan said. 'I cannot tell the supplier this newcomer has exposed a fraud. We have a copied description, different depot marks and an offered unloading account.' He read the three items back to Yue. One missed word could turn their question into a claim they could not support. She corrected his phrase about the depot and watched him correct his own notice.

career_kiln_shift_one_08.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_one_08.text: Near noon, the crew moved the tubs to their assigned shelves. Yue counted the last cover on the board and found that her temporary label had transferred to her sleeve. Jian wanted to laugh and did, after she held up the sleeve herself. They restored the label against the receiving tally before the tub moved. The mistake was small. The repair was specific. Yue preferred both facts to the flattering possibility that nobody would have noticed.

career_kiln_shift_one_09.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_shift_one_09.text: Peng reviewed the completed tally against the crew's weights. One uncertain tub stayed uncertain; eleven matched entries were released to their named shelves. The disputed tub's delay did not suspend the carter's completed transport payment. His cover returns were signed separately. Peng asked Yue to explain the sleeve label and kept the answer in the training record. 'A repaired error is useful evidence,' she said. 'It is not evidence you could never lose another label.'

career_kiln_shift_one_10.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_one_10.text: The shift ended with the board cleaned, the remaining tub isolated and the carter carrying his signed copy. Luo checked the actual hours, then Peng paid six copper. Yue counted it only after the coins reached her hand. The wage was for receiving work completed under supervision; the questionable clay had not become her property or her solved discovery. She entered the six beside her two-copper notebook purchase and closed the purse before starting personal notes.

career_kiln_shift_one_11.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_shift_one_11.text: At supper Jian asked whether she regretted returning to such small work. Yue remembered the scale date, her sleeve, and the purchaser who would receive bowls from verified stock. She said small work could embarrass her very thoroughly. Jian grinned, then admitted he had expected five stages to make her impossible to correct. She had expected being remembered to make correction easier. They agreed that both expectations had cost them a useful afternoon.

career_kiln_shift_one_12.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_one_12.text: Before bed she copied the completed receiving lesson into her own notebook. The actual tally stayed with Peng, and the tub stayed where Luo had assigned it. Her reference packet remained the lesson she had chosen, waiting for a later review. Six copper had arrived, one supervised shift had finished, and nothing in her body had advanced beyond her earned four pairs. For once those separate results felt ample.

career_kiln_shift_two.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_two.text: The second shift used the isolated indicator stand and the household order's cold samples. Yue's job was to prepare a comparison station, observe its closure checks and keep each reading attached to the correct vessel. Luo would operate the source; Zhu would handle the sample selection. A technician could support that work without feeding the circuit personally. Yue put her cultivation record away and laid out the ordinary tools first.

career_kiln_shift_two_02.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_shift_two_02.text: Zhu placed six bowls on the cold rack. Three came from the verified current batch and three were retained comparison pieces. The purchaser had requested a smooth broad rim for washing cloth. One retained piece looked more graceful and pinched the cloth when drawn across it. 'Beauty is still allowed,' Zhu said, seeing Yue smile. 'It just has to survive sharing the room with what somebody wants to do.'

career_kiln_shift_two_03.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_two_03.text: Yue copied the six sample numbers onto removable tags. Luo asked her to walk him through the shutter before connecting the isolated source. She identified admission, stop and physical closure in their current order. He deliberately interrupted her with a question about the delivery clock. She lost her place. The source stayed disconnected while she began again. The demonstration was irritating because she understood exactly why it belonged before the live comparison.

career_kiln_shift_two_04.speaker: luo_sheng
career_kiln_shift_two_04.text: Luo wanted the station ready before the afternoon firing crew returned. The pressure was real: there was only one isolated stand, and another paid team needed it. He showed Yue the reserved time on the board, then asked which part she could safely shorten. She could prepare tags while Zhu selected pieces, but she could not omit the dry closure. He accepted the overlap and went to move the rack himself. His impatience had found a permissible job.

career_kiln_shift_two_05.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_shift_two_05.text: During the first comparison, the needle stopped above its expected return mark. Yue called the stop before choosing a cause. Luo closed the admission and shutter; Zhu kept the sample in its numbered cradle. No one reached into the guarded space to improve the reading by hand. Yue wrote the observed mark and time. Only after closure did Luo inspect the dial mount. Its fixing screw had loosened during the morning move.

career_kiln_shift_two_06.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_two_06.text: The loose mount could explain a changed reading, but replacing it would not prove the vessel sound. The stand's responsible operator secured the mount and performed its calibration comparison using the permitted reference portion. Yue kept the interrupted vessel observation separate. Zhu decided it needed a fresh trial after the stand passed. The delay used the station's available slack; it did not take a later team's booked time without asking them.

career_kiln_shift_two_07.speaker: tan_ning
career_kiln_shift_two_07.text: Tan came to ask why the first results were late. Yue showed him the interrupted reading, the loose mount and the separate calibration check. 'So I may tell the purchaser a loose screw spoiled an observation,' he said, 'not that the bowl failed?' She confirmed it. He looked relieved and disappointed together. A failed bowl would make a simpler message. He left with the harder accurate one and a revised time the workers could actually meet.

career_kiln_shift_two_08.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_two_08.text: After the stand passed its check, Zhu returned the held vessel for a new observation. It met the current comparison limit. The earlier interruption remained in the record, with no invented failure hidden behind the later pass. Yue turned to the remaining samples and found she had reversed two tags on her board. Their physical cradle numbers preserved the correct identities. She restored the correspondence in front of both supervisors before anything was released.

career_kiln_shift_two_09.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_shift_two_09.text: Zhu asked Yue to read every surviving tag back to its cradle. The correction took most of the slack left by the mount problem. 'I wish you had been wrong more tidily,' she said, then admitted she had once numbered a whole tray upside down. Her own story did not clear Yue's work. The repeated check did. The last bowl's broad rim remained a better fit for the purchaser even though the graceful comparison piece passed its material limit.

career_kiln_shift_two_10.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_two_10.text: They finished six usable observations within the reserved station period. This shift consumed two permitted comparison portions. An earlier indicator lesson, if selected, had consumed one separate portion recorded in its own packet. The hall's twelve-copper allowance covered that stock and paid review time; no cost entered Jian's wages. Yue returned the key, cleaned the tag board and watched the next team bring their task sheet through the door. The shared stand was free when their booking began.

career_kiln_shift_two_11.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_shift_two_11.text: Peng compared the completed station record with Luo's source record and Zhu's cradle list. The interrupted reading remained excluded from the vessel result. Both tag corrections were visible. She accepted the completed support shift and paid another six copper, bringing Yue's received wages to twelve. The practical review would still be allowed to reject her method. Peng's signature certified this paid work, not the possible appointment the vacancy notice had advertised.

career_kiln_shift_two_12.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_two_12.text: Zhu took her blue display tile back to its shelf. The afternoon had left no time for its repeat firing, so her hoped-for exhibition entry would wait. Yue had almost offered to squeeze it into the completed station period. She was glad she had not said it. Friendship made the unfinished tile matter; it did not provide another booking. Zhu bought them ordinary tea and complained about gray pottery with exactly the affection she had for it.

career_kiln_shift_two_13.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_shift_two_13.text: With two supervised shifts finished, Yue could name three parts of the possible technician work she wanted. She liked catching a misleading instrument, listening to the vessel's intended use, and making a source record survivable. Each specialty would receive the same initial trial wage. The first appointment had one vacancy and one paid development allowance. She could choose what she wanted the review to qualify, leaving the other two specialist needs with the hall.

career_kiln_specialization_choice.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_specialization_choice.text: The appointment offered one specialty: ordinary observation and closure support at the isolated stand, cold examination of household vessels, or retained-source comparison for receiving records. Each began under a named review schedule. Personal qi operation, hot-post clearance and independent kiln certification lay outside all three. Peng asked Yue to choose the scope she wanted assessed. Choosing it would reserve a question for the review; only demonstrated work could earn the title.

choices.text: Develop as an isolated-stand observation technician.
Develop as a cold-vessel examination technician.
Develop as a receiving-source records technician.

career_kiln_specialty_indicator.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_specialty_indicator.text: Yue chose the isolated stand's observation role. She wanted to learn why a needle persuaded people even when its mounting was loose. This scope used ordinary controls and the stand's own source; her four pairs were neither a condition nor a substitute for the closure method. The appointment would give her two supervised development sessions, not authority to operate every array. Luo wrote the specific equipment model into the requested review.

career_kiln_specialty_indicator_02.speaker: luo_sheng
career_kiln_specialty_indicator_02.text: Luo admitted he had hoped she would choose this role because it would make his crowded mornings easier. Peng entered that interest beside his training report. His demonstrations would count as evidence, while another worker would check the ordinary sequence and recorded observations. He could still tell Yue where she had erred. He could not convert his need for assistance into a passed examination.

career_kiln_specialty_indicator_03.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_specialty_indicator_03.text: Zhu would witness the dry physical sequence and compare the numbered cold outcomes. She did not claim authority over Yue's meridians or a live array. Her part tested whether the declared observation job could be done without misidentifying vessels or bypassing the shutter. Yue asked her to be difficult. Zhu said that invitation seemed unnecessary and then carefully wrote the limits of her part beneath her name.

career_kiln_specialty_indicator_04.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_specialty_indicator_04.text: The requested specialty went into the requested appointment record. Its later consequence would be work at the isolated stand within the demonstrated ordinary scope. It left the vessel-design consultation and receiving-source work with its present staff. She took the cold handling sheet anyway because the shared third shift would use it. Ambition had acquired a particular bench, and giving it that shape made the other benches newly tempting.

career_kiln_specialty_vessel.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_specialty_vessel.text: Yue chose the cold-vessel examination role. She wanted to ask what a household needed before admiring the shape on the shelf. The requested title would cover cold stability, rim-use comparison and traceable sample handling within the hall's current method. It would not certify hot performance, change clay composition or license a firing program. Zhu gave her the purchaser's permitted use note and asked her to read the unflattering parts too.

career_kiln_specialty_vessel_02.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_specialty_vessel_02.text: The purchaser valued washing cloth without catching it on the rim, stable placement on the household board and a vessel that did not demand two hands to move empty. Zhu loved a curve that complicated the last requirement. She admitted it before teaching the review method. Her design preference would stay in the record; the observed use test and an independent label check would settle the specific qualification. Yue respected the admission more than a declaration of perfect neutrality.

career_kiln_specialty_vessel_03.speaker: tan_ning
career_kiln_specialty_vessel_03.text: Tan would check the receiving numbers against the actual purchaser's scope. He could establish that the offered sample represented the promised household batch. He would not sign a material conclusion merely because the order depended on it. Peng added that commercial interest to his review role. Yue watched a possible appointment become slower on paper and safer to understand. She still wanted it badly enough that the slowness hurt.

career_kiln_specialty_vessel_04.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_specialty_vessel_04.text: The requested specialty entered the requested appointment record. Its later consequence would be cold examination for the household bench, leaving instrument support and receiving-source work to other staff. Yue would begin with two supervised development sessions if she qualified. Zhu's blue tile still waited for a different booking and a different test. Being chosen as a colleague would not turn Yue's future hours into a free display workshop.

career_kiln_specialty_source.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_specialty_source.text: Yue chose the receiving-source records role. She wanted a worker years later to be able to distinguish an uncertain label from an unfinished person's life. The requested scope covered copying, bounded comparison, specimen correspondence and visible unresolved entries. It granted no power to settle private credit by handwriting, own the specimens or reveal protected care records. Peng placed a sealed private folder beyond the work boundary without asking Yue what she thought it contained.

career_kiln_specialty_source_02.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_specialty_source_02.text: Peng would supervise the record method, so her report alone could not grant the appointment. Tan would compare the permitted copies against his current originals; Zhu would check that the specimen numbers actually led to the right cold pieces. Their interests and limits would accompany the result. Peng looked pleased to have help and tired of arranging checks on it. Yue said tired seemed fair. The vacancy was practical enough to have practical inconveniences.

career_kiln_specialty_source_03.speaker: tan_ning
career_kiln_specialty_source_03.text: Tan offered to prepare a wonderfully legible test sheet. Peng required the actual permitted source instead. A technician would encounter washed digits and narrow margins, not only the source a teacher wished the world supplied. Tan surrendered the clean sheet with theatrical grief. Yue recognized the same temptation in her bright notebook: a tidy page that made thinking look more finished than it was. Peng added an authorized copy of the older unreadable source to this specialty packet.

career_kiln_specialty_source_04.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_specialty_source_04.text: The requested specialty entered the requested appointment record. Its later consequence would be receiving-source work with two supervised development sessions after qualification. Instrument observation and vessel examination would remain other workers' responsibilities. Yue would be able to retrieve the permitted public questions without becoming custodian of every private folder. She liked the work's quietness and feared the confidence of a sentence copied beautifully enough to stop looking doubtful.

career_kiln_shift_three.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_three.text: The third shift began with a cooled rack of household bowls. Yue would prepare its numbered cold samples, complete the permitted correspondence sheet and then use the remaining paid time for practical review. Nobody asked her to reach above her shoulder. A rack handler moved the upper pieces onto the waist-height bench. The final shift's wages would come after its completed work and review time, whether the appointment was offered or refused.

career_kiln_shift_three_02.speaker: jian_rong
career_kiln_shift_three_02.text: Jian wanted to prepare the test pieces. Zhu assigned him the ordinary tray covers instead; a learner could not make another applicant's independent test into a favor. He carried the covers carefully and looked at Yue's vacancy card. 'I hoped you would get it,' he said. 'Then I hoped you would find it difficult.' She thanked him for the first hope and said the second one had already been answered.

career_kiln_shift_three_03.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_three_03.text: A bowl slid when the handler moved the rack. Yue's hand rose by reflex, then stopped below the prohibited reach. The handler used the rack's catch board; the bowl struck its padded edge and chipped. Nobody's shoulder became its replacement brake. The chipped bowl left the sale tray for a separately labeled comparison place. Yue wrote what happened while Luo checked the rack. The purchaser would receive a sound replacement, reducing the hall's spare stock by one.

career_kiln_shift_three_04.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_shift_three_04.text: Zhu inspected the rack after Luo's mechanical check. Its catch board had done the job for which it existed, but the padding needed replacement before the next loaded move. She wrote the ordinary maintenance task and did not ask Yue to prove courage by reaching farther. The chipped bowl disappointed her. It had the cleanest blue rim in the batch. A disappointment could be worth saying aloud without being allowed to redirect somebody else's body.

career_kiln_shift_three_05.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_three_05.text: The remaining numbered cold samples matched the batch correspondence sheet. Yue set aside the chipped piece with the handling event attached, rather than calling it a firing failure. She knew how quickly a dramatic chip could acquire a more convenient story. Tan confirmed the replacement against the order quantity. The hall's one spare became part of the purchaser's promised delivery, leaving no hidden extra for a display entry or a second break.

career_kiln_shift_three_06.speaker: tan_ning
career_kiln_shift_three_06.text: Tan sent the purchaser the revised dispatch time and retained the handling loss in the hall's account. The customer had not bought a mystery about why the finest blue rim stayed behind. When Jian asked if he should describe the chip as training, Tan answered that training was happening around it; the chip itself came from a rack move. Yue liked the sentence. She copied it into her private notebook after the actual correspondence work was finished.

career_kiln_shift_three_07.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_shift_three_07.text: Peng checked the completed sample preparation, then cleared the table for the practical review. Yue's first lesson packet would determine an additional reference question before the shared dry test. Peng could see which packet had been issued in the ordinary training record. If that record was unavailable, the review could continue with the shared current materials; nobody would infer a past lesson or count it as completed from Yue's confident voice.

career_kiln_review_reference.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_review_reference.text: Yue placed the authorized packet beside the current sample sheet. The earlier learning decision now mattered: its crossed-out conclusion, imperfect placement or provisional digit supplied a different question. Peng checked the issued packet before directing the review. The shared examination remained available without a recoverable old record. Yue looked at her bright notebook and realized she had used most of its first pages learning how a conclusion could arrive too soon.

career_kiln_review_indicator.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_review_indicator.text: Peng asked what the first instrument packet established. Yue answered that the two unpowered dials had shown an offset related to temperature within that comparison. It did not certify the active stand. Peng opened the crossed-out diagnosis. Yue explained why she had wanted to call a defect before comparing the second dial. Wanting to be useful after returning had made a small movement look like an invitation to prove she belonged.

career_kiln_review_indicator_02.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_review_indicator_02.text: Zhu set two cold indicator faces beside the packet. One face had a shifted printed scale, while its mechanical pointer remained at the same position as the other. Yue initially described different readings, then checked the reference marks and revised the statement. The review used no live source. It asked whether her declared observation skill could distinguish the instrument's movement from the labels laid around it.

career_kiln_review_indicator_03.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_review_indicator_03.text: Yue identified the shifted scale and kept both raw readings in the answer. She did not offer to repair a face she had permission only to inspect. The practical explanation passed this reference question, with the initial wording and correction retained. Luo listened without signing it. He had trained the first instrument lesson and wanted the appointment filled; the record needed more than his relief at hearing an answer he liked.

career_kiln_review_indicator_04.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_review_indicator_04.text: Her instrument packet now carried a witnessed reference response. It would support a later assignment in which a dial's printed scale needed checking before the physical pointer could persuade anyone. It did not remove the shared dry examination or grant the chosen specialty. Yue packed the two cold faces into their numbered sleeves. Peng called for the common household sample, which could embarrass an instrument student as readily as anybody else.

career_kiln_review_vessel.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_review_vessel.text: Zhu asked Yue to explain the first cold packet. Yue described the broad bowl that rocked, the small bowl shifted by a crumb, and the authorized outlines that preserved the original pieces. She had initially wanted to repair the high foot without permission. The review answer included that desire. It was easier to confess now that no abrasive had touched the retained bowl, and still uncomfortable to hear it read back in front of Peng.

career_kiln_review_vessel_02.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_review_vessel_02.text: The reference question used another retained bowl on two household boards. On the smoother board it stood; on the warped board it rocked. Yue checked both surfaces before attributing the movement to the vessel. The purchaser's permitted note named a household board with its own unevenness. The relevant result would therefore include that context. A perfect answer for the hall's polished bench could still fail the person buying the bowl.

career_kiln_review_vessel_03.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_review_vessel_03.text: She recorded that the sample's placement was stable on the flat reference surface within the cold trial, and unsuitable for reliable placement on the offered warped board. Zhu accepted the bounded comparison. Tan checked that the copied household note retained its actual scope. Neither result certified hot performance. Yue felt the pleasure of answering a real use question without having to pretend the material had supplied a universal truth.

career_kiln_review_vessel_04.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_review_vessel_04.text: Her vessel packet now carried a witnessed reference response. It would support a later household assignment involving a sound piece and an unsuitable surface. The appointment still depended on the shared dry examination and the chosen specialty's demonstrated work. Zhu returned the offered board to its owner through the agreed handler. The polished reference board stayed in the hall, beautiful in its limited way and incapable of standing in for every table.

career_kiln_review_source.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_review_source.text: Peng asked what the first source packet had corrected. Yue answered that Tan's copied digit needed a provisional status; the unreadable original digit remained unknown. The one-day difference on another specimen named firing and later removal, not a discovered conflict. Peng asked her to put the surviving uncertainty into one usable sentence. Yue wrote it, scratched out a grand word about restoration, and tried again with the dates and actual source names.

career_kiln_review_source_02.speaker: tan_ning
career_kiln_review_source_02.text: Tan offered the permitted current receiving copy with two adjacent lines partly hidden by a fold. Yue read the visible amount correctly and almost attached it to the wrong tub. He waited until she compared the whole line against the unfolded original. The source's condition explained the temptation, not the correctness of her first association. She corrected the correspondence and retained the first draft where the practical reviewers could inspect it.

career_kiln_review_source_03.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_review_source_03.text: She explained why a matched amount did not identify a tub by itself. The final packet included the permitted original comparison, the corrected correspondence and the fold's position. Zhu independently located the numbered cold specimen. The reference question passed only after that check. Yue wished the line had been easier and knew an easy substitute sheet would have tested a different skill from the receiving-source work she hoped to perform.

career_kiln_review_source_04.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_review_source_04.text: Her source packet now carried a witnessed reference response. It would support a later assignment involving a folded current sheet, leaving the old unreadable digit unresolved. Tan reclaimed his original and Yue retained only the authorized copy. The shared dry examination remained ahead. Peng swept a little dust off its table and then stopped sweeping until Yue had seen exactly what remained on the surface she was about to trust.

career_kiln_review_shared.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_review_shared.text: The shared dry examination used an unpowered indicator, three cold bowls and the current receiving sheet. Yue had to keep identities intact, demonstrate the physical closure order and report the limits of a cold placement result. Zhu and Peng checked different parts; Tan retained his original for correspondence. Luo observed outside the assessment signatures. No live circuit depended on the candidate's answer, and no production piece would be released merely because she wanted the title.

career_kiln_review_shared_02.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_review_shared_02.text: Yue matched the three bowl numbers, demonstrated the shutter and placed the first bowl on the reference board. It stood. She wrote stable within the trial before checking the board's underside. Zhu asked her to complete the surface check. A folded scrap beneath one corner had tilted the whole board enough to counter the bowl's uneven foot. Yue stared at the scrap. She had examined what was on the board and forgotten the board itself.

career_kiln_review_shared_03.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_review_shared_03.text: 'That result cannot pass,' Zhu said. She moved the scrap after recording its position, then repeated the placement with the unchanged bowl. It rocked. The initial board condition belonged to a contained dry test; no customer's order or worker's live circuit had been exposed. Zhu kept Yue's first signed result beside the correction. A later pass would show recovered method. It would not make this answer a pass in retrospect.

career_kiln_review_shared_04.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_review_shared_04.text: Yue wanted to accuse the test of trickery. She heard the accusation before saying it and looked at the real reference method, which included checking the surface and its supports. The scrap tested a requirement she had skipped. Her earlier packet contained a different misleading condition she had learned to examine. Neither memory had made attention automatic. Peng let the silence last long enough for the anger to lose its easiest story.

career_kiln_review_shared_05.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_review_shared_05.text: Peng recorded a failed first practical attempt within the paid third shift. Wages already earned remained earned; today would still pay for its actual completed work and review time. The hall had reserved time for one coached repetition and an independent retest. Yue could use that time or stop without receiving a title. Peng asked her to say what needed relearning before choosing a repetition method.

career_kiln_review_shared_06.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_review_shared_06.text: 'I treated the reference surface as a fact instead of part of the setup,' Yue answered. 'I checked the vessel and labels, then stopped asking questions.' It sounded less flattering than saying she had been hurried. She had been hurried, and she had also stopped. Zhu offered a checklist with a blank place for the support condition. Yue wanted to memorize it immediately. Peng said they would first have her use it on another actual setup.

career_kiln_review_shared_07.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_review_shared_07.text: The repetition began with the stand empty. Yue followed the physical sequence, inspected the base and compared its numbered faces before any sample went onto it. Then she checked both sides and supports of the cold board. Luo demonstrated the procedure once and withdrew from the assessment position. The correction belonged to a method, not a promise to be more careful. Two unpowered setups still remained for the independent retest.

career_kiln_review_shared_08.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_review_shared_08.text: Zhu offered two ways to use the reserved retest time. With practiced comprehension, Yue could explain the checks independently before the assessors uncovered the conditions. An ordinary coached rehearsal remained available, followed by an equally independent test on the second setup. Neither choice itself completed the test. The coached route would retain a paired checklist for her first job sessions; the independent explanation would retain her written comparison instead.

career_kiln_retest_choice.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_retest_choice.text: Yue had one reserved retest period and no reason to protect her pride by claiming a method she could not demonstrate. She could lead the comparison from practiced comprehension or rehearse the steps with Zhu before a fresh independent test. A successful demonstration would qualify the shared method within its scope. A selected card would qualify nothing. She looked at the board's underside before deciding how to begin.

choices.text: Explain and demonstrate the comparison independently.
Use a coached rehearsal, then face the independent retest.

career_kiln_retest_independent.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_retest_independent.text: Yue explained the new setup before touching its samples: base, surface, supports, numbered correspondence, physical closure and observed result. Peng asked how she would handle a disagreement between the board and the offered household surface. Yue left space for both results rather than declaring one of them universal. Her first failed placement remained on the table. She used it to show the precise check absent from that attempt.

career_kiln_retest_independent_02.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_retest_independent_02.text: The independent retest contained one sound bowl on a warped household board and one uneven bowl on the flat reference board. Yue identified the two different limitations, preserved the numbered correspondence and demonstrated the dry shutter sequence without Luo's prompt. Zhu repeated the cold placements independently; Tan matched the offered sheet. Peng checked that the answer distinguished actual observations from its proposed use. The observed work met the declared shared method.

career_kiln_retest_independent_03.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_retest_independent_03.text: Peng accepted the completed independent retest and attached Yue's written comparison. The first failure remained failed, the later demonstration passed, and both retained their dates. Yue had learned to compare the setup as carefully as its result. The title still required the chosen specialty's final witnessed task. She retrieved the checklist anyway. Passing without its prompts did not make the paper an enemy or remove the board's underside from tomorrow's world.

career_kiln_retest_coached.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_retest_coached.text: Zhu rehearsed the sequence with Yue on the first setup, naming each omitted step before the sample moved. Yue repeated the surface and support checks until she could explain why both mattered. The rehearsal was recorded as coached work. Zhu then removed that setup, leaving a second numbered arrangement prepared for the independent retest. The assistance would not be concealed inside a claim that Yue had passed alone on her first try.

career_kiln_retest_coached_02.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_retest_coached_02.text: On the fresh setup Yue checked the warped household board, flat reference surface and two numbered bowls without another prompt. She reported where each placement was usable and where it was not. Zhu repeated the cold result; Tan matched the offered sheet against his original. Peng watched the dry shutter demonstration. The test supported the declared shared method, retaining the earlier failure and coached rehearsal as distinct parts of how Yue reached it.

career_kiln_retest_coached_03.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_retest_coached_03.text: Peng accepted the completed retest after coaching. The first job sessions would retain a paired checklist until the named review, an ordinary support within the requested role. Yue had finished difficult corrective practice after a real failure instead of protecting her pride by leaving. Her wages did not shrink because she needed the rehearsal. The title still depended on the chosen specialty's witnessed task, which would test the same method inside a different responsibility.

career_kiln_review_pass.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_review_pass.text: Yue's shared retest passed within the declared ordinary scope. It established sample identity, setup examination, dry closure and bounded reporting. It did not certify a hot post or enlarge the isolated stand's permitted load. Peng read the result aloud, including the failed first attempt. Yue heard the appointment becoming possible and resisted the urge to treat possible as already held. One specialty task remained inside the paid third shift.

career_kiln_review_pass_02.speaker: jian_rong
career_kiln_review_pass_02.text: Jian waited outside the review room with the covered tray. Yue told him she had failed and passed, in that order. He asked whether both would stay in the record. When she said yes, he smiled with less sharpness than before. His own qualification remained unfinished; her result did not award him an outcome by friendship. He carried the tray to its actual cupboard and returned to the task his teacher had assigned.

career_kiln_retest_policy.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_retest_policy.text: Peng attached the completed retest method to the requested job plan. The independent explanation and the coached rehearsal led to different first-session supports. Both retained their own demonstrated result, and neither erased the first failure. A missing earlier decision supplied no invented method; the current appointment review could still use its shared witnessed evidence. Yue waited while Peng checked the practical record against the actual selected retest.

career_kiln_policy_independent.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_policy_independent.text: The independent retest had earned a first-session plan built around Yue's written comparison. She would lead the explanation within the declared ordinary scope while the named reviewer checked the setup and result. Leading that explanation would not make the review unnecessary. The plan reserved actual paid hours for both people. Peng gave her the copy, and Yue saw a small future responsibility she could name without calling herself finished.

career_kiln_policy_independent_02.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_policy_independent_02.text: Yue accepted the explanation role and retained the checklist as a tool she could still use. She wanted tomorrow's confidence to look less like refusing help and more like knowing which part she could presently lead. Luo would retain source operation where the job required it; Zhu and Tan would retain their own review parts. Her chosen specialty would decide the actual bench, leaving the other needs with their current staff.

career_kiln_policy_coached.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_policy_coached.text: The coached retest had earned a first-session plan with paired setup checks. Yue would perform the method while the named reviewer read the support conditions with her before the observation. This was a funded work arrangement, not an unpaid obligation to remain beside a teacher forever. The plan named a review date and allowed a later independent explanation if demonstrated. Peng gave her the copy without pretending the earlier coaching had never happened.

career_kiln_policy_coached_02.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_policy_coached_02.text: Yue accepted the paired checklist. She had wanted a qualification to make needing help less visible, then watched help produce the result the first attempt had missed. The appointment could keep that ordinary history without making it her permanent limit. Luo would retain source operation where required, and the other reviewers their declared parts. Her chosen specialty still needed its own witnessed task before the trainee card could be changed.

career_kiln_appointment.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_appointment.text: Peng checked the requested specialty against the earlier appointment decision. The three possible jobs had different final tasks, different people waiting for their results and different unfilled needs. Yue could earn the one she had actually requested. If no request could be recovered, the completed common work would still receive its wages, with no specialty title inferred. The review now turned from how she had learned to what she proposed to be responsible for.

career_kiln_qualify_indicator.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_qualify_indicator.text: The final indicator task used the current isolated stand with admission locked. Yue compared its physical pointer, printed face, base support and numbered specimen record. One printed mark had shifted under its cover. The stand could not be treated as ready for use until the responsible operator replaced and checked that face. Yue documented the mismatch rather than turning a plausible needle position into a release instruction.

career_kiln_qualify_indicator_02.speaker: luo_sheng
career_kiln_qualify_indicator_02.text: Luo replaced the face under his own equipment responsibility and performed the permitted calibration check. Yue observed and recorded its return, calling a stop when the first reading moved outside the mark. The retained comparison showed a loose outer pointer guard. Luo corrected the guard and repeated the check; her next observation matched the independent record. His signature covered his operation. Zhu's separate comparison covered the sample identities and dry closure.

career_kiln_qualify_indicator_03.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_qualify_indicator_03.text: Peng reviewed the two observed checks, the corrected equipment and the independently matched sample record. The result qualified Yue for ordinary observation and closure support on this isolated stand model, with the first-session support already agreed. Personal qi feeding, hot-post operation and unfamiliar circuits remained outside the role. The title was qualified observation technician, earned after the specific task. The hall's broader certification remained with its responsible specialists.

career_kiln_qualify_indicator_04.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_qualify_indicator_04.text: Luo replaced Yue's trainee task card with the scoped technician card only after Peng accepted the completed review. The appointment offered four weeks at seven copper per completed shift, with actual hours and two development sessions named before each booking. The hall reserved eight copper for those sessions and review; unused money stayed in its account. Yue accepted the first booking. Future wages had not yet been earned, and the card did not create an unpaid continuous watch.

career_kiln_qualify_indicator_05.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_qualify_indicator_05.text: Her first assignment would keep the indicator's checks visible before the next household comparison. The vessel-use consultation remained with Zhu, and the folded receiving sheet with Peng and Tan. Yue had not filled every need by choosing this one. She placed her earned card beside the corrected face, then returned the equipment key to its operator. The completed task had made her more willing to question a persuasive needle and less ashamed of needing its answer checked.

career_kiln_qualify_vessel.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_qualify_vessel.text: The final vessel task used three numbered cold pieces from the household batch and the purchaser's offered cloth. Yue checked the reference board and its supports before placing anything. Two rims let the cloth travel smoothly; one caught a loose thread at its joining point. She recorded the snag with the actual sample number. The material observation did not become a judgment about the purchaser's skill, nor a universal defect in every bowl of that shape.

career_kiln_qualify_vessel_02.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_qualify_vessel_02.text: Zhu repeated the cloth comparison and found the same snag. Her preferred curve belonged to the rejected piece, an annoyance she said aloud before putting it outside the order. Yue selected a permitted sound replacement and repeated the placement and use comparison. Tan matched that replacement to the purchaser's actual quantity. The one spare had already replaced the rack loss, so this change drew from a separately available sale piece at the hall's cost.

career_kiln_qualify_vessel_03.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_qualify_vessel_03.text: Peng accepted the independently repeated cold results and the verified sample correspondence. Yue qualified for cold stability, rim-use comparison and traceable handling under the hall's present household method. She received the title qualified vessel-examination technician within that scope. Hot performance, firing-program certification and material composition remained separate questions. Zhu's pleasure in having a colleague did not expand the signed result; neither did the buyer's approaching feast.

career_kiln_qualify_vessel_04.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_qualify_vessel_04.text: Zhu changed the trainee card only after the completed review. The appointment offered four weeks at seven copper per completed shift, with actual hours and two development sessions named before each booking. Eight copper was reserved for those sessions and review, returning unused money to the hall's account. Yue accepted the first household-bench booking. The blue display tile remained a separate future project, requiring its own place, material tests and payment.

career_kiln_qualify_vessel_05.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_qualify_vessel_05.text: Her first assignment would begin by reading the next purchaser's actual use note. Instrument observation stayed with Luo's support plan; the folded receiving source stayed with Peng and Tan. Yue had earned a particular role and left two other needs with their present workers. She cleaned the offered cloth under its owner's terms and returned it. Understanding the customer's use had become a practiced responsibility, rather than a sympathetic thought that arrived after a beautiful bowl was sold.

career_kiln_qualify_source.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_qualify_source.text: The final source task used the folded receiving sheet from the current household batch. Yue compared the permitted original with its copy, then located the numbered cold specimen with Zhu. A visible amount belonged to the line below the one she first followed. She identified the association before signing it. The correction stayed beside the preserved copy, which would let another reviewer see why the fold had tempted a wrong correspondence.

career_kiln_qualify_source_02.speaker: tan_ning
career_kiln_qualify_source_02.text: Tan checked the corrected copy against the original and signed only the correspondence he could actually verify. The earlier unreadable digit in the specialty packet remained unreadable. No new page repaired that older absence. Zhu independently matched the specimen, and Peng checked the unresolved-status field. Yue's final record made the current batch usable while leaving an older question visible. Its cleanliness came from separated claims, not from removing every awkward mark.

career_kiln_qualify_source_03.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_qualify_source_03.text: Peng accepted the witnessed copy, specimen match and uncertainty record. Yue earned the title qualified receiving-source technician for copying, bounded comparison and traceable specimen correspondence. She could not adjudicate private credit, own retained failures or reveal protected folders. Peng's training report was joined by Tan's original comparison and Zhu's physical match, so the vacancy was not filled merely on its supervisor's wish. The old disputed cooling date remained assigned to its existing reviewer.

career_kiln_qualify_source_04.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_qualify_source_04.text: Peng changed the trainee card after the completed practical review. The appointment offered four weeks at seven copper per completed shift, with actual hours and two development sessions agreed before each booking. Eight copper was reserved for those sessions and review; unused money stayed with the hall. Yue accepted the first receiving-desk booking. She received access to the permitted work shelf, while the protected folders kept their existing custodian and access rules.

career_kiln_qualify_source_05.speaker: lin_yue
career_kiln_qualify_source_05.text: Her first assignment would preserve the folded sheet's usable correspondence without guessing the old missing digit. Instrument support stayed with Luo's plan; household vessel consultation with Zhu. Yue had filled the role she requested while leaving other needs with their present workers. She returned Tan's original and stored the authorized copy on its actual shelf. A well-copied sentence could now carry her uncertainty clearly enough for someone else to question it.

career_kiln_shift_three_pay.speaker: peng_ai
career_kiln_shift_three_pay.text: Peng closed the third shift's actual work and paid its six copper. Yue's received trainee wages now totaled eighteen, independent of the first failed test and the later appointment decision. Her two-copper notebook and one reserved copper for postage left fifteen unallocated from this term. The purchaser's replacement costs belonged to the hall's separate loss account. Future technician shifts would pay only after their own completed work; today's envelope contained no advance disguised as an earned wage.

career_kiln_shift_three_pay_02.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_shift_three_pay_02.text: The supervised term had finished: three actual shifts, one contained failed attempt, corrective practice and a witnessed retest. Yue's own original cultivation examination still supported her earned fifth stage. The career review supported its narrower ordinary work result. She returned the trial keys and retained her authorized practical record. The job card, where offered, named the specialty's limits and first-session support. Peng placed no new realm notation beside the paid amount.

career_kiln_finish.speaker: narrator
career_kiln_finish.text: That evening the kitchen sounded as it had before her departure, with someone complaining about the tea and someone defending it much too loudly. Yue had returned as an applicant and completed a new paid term. Its practical record held the first failure where another reader could find it. The next employment decision would have its own dates, tasks and money. For once the future looked concrete enough to want without pretending it was already accomplished.

career_kiln_finish_02.speaker: zhu_yan
career_kiln_finish_02.text: Zhu asked whether Yue's new notebook had room for the blue tile. Yue said it had room for a request, not a reserved firing. Zhu threw a folded clean cloth at her knees.
